description:
## 0.0.22-7 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* New: Translate chat messages. Hold a message with text and tap Translate: Google Translate's pop-up opens over the chat, or Google Translate on the web into Tamil without the app. Switch in HushGram settings > Messages.
* New: Glass sheets. Comments, the share sheet and other sheets that slide up get the Liquid Glass look, with the page behind blurred on Android 12 and newer. Switch in Liquid Glass > Behavior.
* A chat's top bar now looks like glass even over a plain chat: a sheen, a light frost and a lit rim along its bottom.
* Swiping to the next reel, its seek bar no longer shows under the pill for a moment before jumping above it.
